title: Prisma drift-ignore registry
description: Registry of Prisma drift the migration tooling must handle: indexes Prisma cannot represent and must never silently lose (protectedIndexes), and generated SQL fragments to strip from a freshly-diffed migration (ignorePatterns). ENFORCEMENT BOUNDARY: this schema is advisory — it describes the file FORMAT for an editor, and nothing runs it in CI. The mechanically-enforced subset is whatever protectedIndexRegistry.ts validates at load time, which is narrower: `type` is required here but never read there, so omitting it breaks this schema while every automated gate stays green.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors validate the file as you type.

description.description: One-line statement of what this file is for.

protectedIndexes.description: The single source of truth for indexes that must never be dropped without a recreate in the same migration. Loaded and validated at module load by packages/tooling/src/db/protectedIndexRegistry.ts; an empty array is rejected there, because checking zero indexes looks identical to "all migrations are safe".

name.description: Exact Postgres index name. Reported verbatim when a violation is found, so it must not be empty.

table.description: Table the index is defined on. Reported by db:inspect.

type.description: Why Prisma cannot represent the index — e.g. "ivfflat" (pgvector operator class) or "partial" (WHERE clause).

description.description: What the index is for and what breaks without it. Reported verbatim by both db:check-safety and db:inspect, so it must not be empty.

recreateSQL.description: Complete CREATE INDEX statement that restores the index, ready to paste into psql. Printed by db:inspect when the index is missing from a live database.

dropPattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matching a DROP of this index in migration SQL. Must compile; an empty pattern would match every file, so it is rejected.

createPattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matching a CREATE of this index in migration SQL. A drop is a violation only when this does NOT also match the same file. Must compile; an empty pattern would make every drop look balanced.

ignorePatterns.description: SQL fragments to strip from Prisma's generated migration before it is written. Consumed by db:safe-migrate (create-safe-migration.ts).

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against each line of the generated migration.

reason.description: Why this generated SQL must not survive — the reader's only explanation for a line silently disappearing.

action.description: What to do with a matching line. Only "remove" is implemented by the sanitizer.

documentation.description: Repo-relative pointers to the prose that explains this file.
